queries:
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE ab.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.tradekind;

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.abhvreg) AS matched_count
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg
JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.tradekind

SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS matched_transaction_records
FROM advancedbehavior ab
JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
WHERE ab.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.tradekind
